lead.headline: Coker is unlikely to play, and he's still in your flex
lead.deck: ESPN cut him from 13.0 to 0.0 overnight. Put Kamara in the flex now; the slot locks at 18:20. Everything else is the projection lineup, pending the inactive lists.
lead.body: Jalen Coker's quad got its answer early. Adam Schefter reported this morning that he is unlikely to play against Detroit tonight, and ESPN cut his projection from 13.0 to 0.0. He is still listed questionable, and he is still in your flex. Terry McLaurin is officially inactive in London and Justin Jefferson is out, so three of your five receivers are down and the flex has to be a running back. The projection picks Alvin Kamara: 10.6, not on the Saints' report, in a three-man committee against an Atlanta front that has been hard to run on. He plays Monday night, so the swap costs nothing to make now, and it has to be made before 18:20 tonight, when a sitting Coker would lock the slot at zero. If Carolina's inactives at 16:50 show Coker active, look at ESPN's number again and swap back only if it is two or more above Kamara's. Elsewhere nothing moved overnight. Josh Allen was never on Buffalo's report, Jordan Addison is Minnesota's top receiver against a stingy Miami secondary, Isaiah Likely's routes are intact with Jameis Winston throwing, and Chicago are still expected to start Tyson Bagent, which touches only the benched Kyle Monangai. This is the run before the inactive lists: check each starter 90 minutes before his kickoff. On the wire, nothing beats Kamara by more than a coin flip today; DK Metcalf and Denzel Boston on Tuesday are the real answer to the receiver room.

cannotSee.body: footballdb's tables are standard scoring through Week 3. Five were re-read today (NE, CHI, MIA, MIN, NYJ); the rest are carried from Saturday's read of the same three weeks. Other sites disagree in places: FantasyTeamAdvice has Denver 29th against kickers where footballdb has them 10th-most. The Vikings D/ST tile is a judgement from Miami's scoring.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN's Coker story and inactives page, Hogs Haven, Pride of Detroit, Big Blue View, Big Cat Country and the Star Tribune were blocked or empty; RotoBaller returned navigation only. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quoted wording is close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own pending claims. Metcalf, Dowdle and Boston clear on Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City; Meyers, Washington and Raymond are free agents anyone can add first. Footballers added Jaylen Wright on Saturday night.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: wire_screen.py counts Week 4 as a stat week once one game is played, so its list is Steelers and Browns plus Tyler Higbee. Both passes returned the same eleven names as Saturday, so the verdicts are carried. It can't see Holani, Lemon, Washington or Raymond; they're in do-not-chase from the ownership column.

cannotSee.label: Legette's injury
cannotSee.body: ESPN and CatCrave say knee; SI's Panthers site says hamstring. Either way he's on injured reserve for at least four games.
